prompt: Of the non-Americans who have won the Phoenix Open as of 2024, who was the youngest at the time of his win?
answer: **Hideki Matsuyama of Japan** was the youngest non-American to win the Phoenix Open as of 2024. He won the **2016 tournament at age 23** (and successfully defended the title in 2017).
